stories.title: The surprising reason women seem better at multitasking than men
summary: Men and women appear to be similarly capable of multitasking, but men are more than twice as likely to ignore conversation while juggling multiple activities.
Researchers believe this unexpected difference may help explain why women are widely perceived as better multitaskers.

stories.title: Deep beneath Australia, hidden caves could unlock the secrets of alien worlds
summary: Scientists have solved the mystery of strange trenches scattered across Australia’s vast Nullarbor Plain, revealing an extensive hidden world beneath the surface.
These subtle landscape features are created as deeply buried cave systems slowly collapse upward over millions of years.
The discovery could help researchers locate unexplored caves containing ancient environmental records and unusual life forms.

stories.title: This 345-million-year-old fossil had scientists fooled for decades
summary: A famous 345-million-year-old fossil has turned out to be something entirely different from what scientists believed for decades.
Advanced X-ray imaging revealed hidden gills and thousands of tiny teeth, exposing a primitive aquatic or amphibious creature rather than an early reptile.
The discovery suggests that several adaptations associated with life on land actually evolved in animals still dependent on water.

stories.title: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea
summary: More than a mile beneath the surface of the Red Sea, scientists have discovered rare underwater lakes that could reveal secrets about Earth's ancient oceans and the possibility of alien life.
Known as brine pools, these extremely salty, oxygen-free environments are surprisingly teeming with microbial life, challenging our understanding of where living organisms can survive.

stories.title: Astronomers may have discovered a black hole born before the first stars
summary: A mysterious object named Phoebe, detected when it briefly magnified a distant star, could be a primordial black hole formed just after the Big Bang.
With an estimated mass only three times that of the Moon, it may be a 13-billion-year-old cosmic relic that offers new clues to the mystery of dark matter.
